pipeline.name: sourcegraph
pipeline.configuration:
# pipeline.yml sets up the appropriate pipeline to run for any given commit through the
# pipeline generator (see steps).
#
# 🚨 SECURITY: DO NOT DEFINE SECRETS HERE IN PIPELINE ENV - instead, go to
# https://sourcegraph.com/github.com/sourcegraph/infrastructure/-/blob/buildkite/kubernetes/gsm-secrets.tf
#
# MUST_INCLUDE_COMMIT, as well as other non-secret variables, are now defined in
# https://sourcegraph.com/github.com/sourcegraph/infrastructure/-/blob/buildkite/kubernetes/buildkite-agent/buildkite-agent.Deployment.yaml

steps:
  - group: ":aspect: Aspect Workflows "
    steps:
      - key: aspect-workflows-upload
        # Disable Aspect Workflows if:
        # 1. DISABLE_ASPECT_WORKFLOWS environment variable is set to "true" (set by sg ci build for docker-images notest builds)
        # 2. Branch matches docker-images-notest/* or docker-images-candidates-notest/* patterns (safety net)
        if: build.env("DISABLE_ASPECT_WORKFLOWS") != "true" && !(build.branch =~ /^(?:docker-images-|executor-patch-)(?:candidates-)?notest/)
        label: ":aspect: Setup Aspect Workflows"
        commands: |
          rosetta steps | buildkite-agent pipeline upload
        agents:
          queue: aspect-small-ubuntu-lts
      - label: ":pipeline: Generate pipeline"
        commands:
          - "./dev/ci/gen-pipeline.sh"
        agents:
          queue: aspect-ubuntu-lts

jobs.name: :aspect: Setup Aspect Workflows
jobs.command: rosetta steps | buildkite-agent pipeline upload

jobs.name: :hammer_and_wrench: Buildifier
jobs.command:
echo "--- :aspect-build: Workflows environment"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/configure_workflows_env
echo "--- :stethoscope: Agent health check"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/agent_health_check
echo "--- :git: Checkout health"
rosetta run checkout --workspace .
echo "~~~ :broom: Prepare archive directories"
rm -rf /workflows/artifacts /workflows/testlogs
echo "--- :hammer_and_wrench: Buildifier"
rosetta run buildifier --workspace .
echo "+++   "

jobs.name: :deer: Gazelle
jobs.command:
echo "--- :aspect-build: Workflows environment"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/configure_workflows_env
echo "--- :stethoscope: Agent health check"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/agent_health_check
echo "--- :git: Checkout health"
rosetta run checkout --workspace .
echo "~~~ :broom: Prepare archive directories"
rm -rf /workflows/artifacts /workflows/testlogs
echo "--- :deer: Gazelle"
rosetta run gazelle --workspace .
echo "+++   "

jobs.name: :bazel: Test
jobs.command:
echo "--- :aspect-build: Workflows environment"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/configure_workflows_env
echo "--- :stethoscope: Agent health check"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/agent_health_check
echo "--- :git: Checkout health"
rosetta run checkout --workspace .
echo "~~~ :broom: Prepare archive directories"
rm -rf /workflows/artifacts /workflows/testlogs
echo "--- :bazel: Test"
rosetta run test --workspace .
echo "+++   "

jobs.name: :bazel: Integration/E2E (Test)
jobs.command:
echo "--- :aspect-build: Workflows environment"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/configure_workflows_env
echo "--- :stethoscope: Agent health check"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/agent_health_check
echo "--- :git: Checkout health"
rosetta run checkout --workspace .
echo "~~~ :broom: Prepare archive directories"
rm -rf /workflows/artifacts /workflows/testlogs
echo "--- :bazel: Integration/E2E (Test)"
rosetta run test_2 --workspace .
echo "+++   "

jobs.name: :aspect-build: Finalization
jobs.command:
echo "--- :aspect-build: Workflows environment"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/configure_workflows_env
echo "--- :stethoscope: Agent health check"
/etc/aspect/workflows/bin/agent_health_check
echo "~~~ :broom: Prepare archive directories"
rm -rf /workflows/artifacts /workflows/testlogs
echo "--- :peacock: Finalization"
rosetta run finalization --workspace .
echo "+++   "

chmod +x ./sg

jobs.name: :golang: Lint
jobs.command:
mise install go golangci-lint
eval "$(mise env)"
go mod tidy
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  echo "Unstaged files after go mod tidy:"
  git status --porcelain
  echo "Run 'go mod tidy' and commit the changes"
  exit 1
fi
golangci-lint run --timeout=30m

jobs.name: :golang: Test
jobs.command:
mise install go
eval "$(mise env)"
go test -shuffle=on -v -race ./...

jobs.name: :pipeline: Upload service pipelines
jobs.command: find .buildkite/pipelines -type f \( -iname '*.yml' -o -iname '*.yaml' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 buildkite-agent pipeline upload --git-diff-base HEAD~1
